method:
SELECT count(*),
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE NULLIF(trim(tags->>'website'), '') IS NOT NULL
                              OR NULLIF(trim(tags->>'contact:website'), '') IS NOT NULL),
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE NULLIF(trim(tags->>'wikidata'), '') IS NOT NULL),
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE NULLIF(trim(tags->>'addr:street'), '') IS NOT NULL)
            FROM hotels
limitation: Local stored tags only; links, identities and page contents have not been verified.
